item.description:
Requests will use JSON and use the following middleware:

- `auth`
- `web`
- `guest`
    

Policies will be used and check token abilities with:

``` php
\Laravel\Sanctum\PersonalAccessToken::can($ability);

 ```

- The ability namespaces will be exploded and checked for wildcards
    

``` json
[
    "app:*",
    "playground:*",
    "playground-auth:*",
    "playground-admin-resource:*",
    "playground-cms-resource:*"
]

 ```

- These are the abilities for an admin user with Playground.
    

``` sql
insert into `personal_access_tokens` 
    (
        `name`, 
        `token`, 
        `abilities`, 
        `expires_at`, 
        `tokenable_id`, 
        `tokenable_type`, 
        `updated_at`, 
        `created_at`
    ) 
    values (
        'app', 
        'e859e9ca71b1509aa7b33fcde91506b6efa8df89d558be45d8907b0dd404c8d8', 
        '[\"app:*\",\"playground:*\",\"playground-auth:*\",\"playground-admin-resource:*\",\"playground-cms-resource:*\"]', 
        '2024-03-30 00:00:00', 
        '9ba2bfcb-935a-4f59-8241-231af11e33d1', 
        'App\\Models\\User', 
        '2024-03-29 18:34:45', 
        '2024-03-29 18:34:45'
);

 ```
